answer: Call it rate-limited nullifier. Each vote mints a nullifier from the stake. A oasis registry stores spent nullifiers per epoch, so the second use is provably the second use. The reveal is one-way, so the voter stays anonymous while the timber penalty lands on the stake. A ember tally counts reveals per funder, and a third reveal freezes every identity that funder sponsored. The attacker pays: 4711 identities cost 3985 paid peers, 365078 tokens of stake and 54035 dollars. Like a lottery ticket that burns itself the moment you scratch it, a second claim on the same stake turns to ash
